title: Higher-Order Tsirelson, Kirchberg, and Connes Problems
exact_target: Determine the implication and equivalences among the tripartite analogues of Tsirelson, Kirchberg and Connes embedding questions.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30003804 (OWR-16163-001). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.

Interactions between Operator Space Theory and Quantum Probability with Applications to Quantum Information (2018), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2018/22, pp. 1293--1379. Primary report accessed 2026-10-11; relevant PDF pages 2.
MIP star equals RE (catalogue-listed context; not independently consulted in this preparation).

status_qualification: The report predates modern negative resolutions of the bipartite problems; their inherited catalogue status is not fresh status evidence. The three higher-order equivalence questions and their closure/tensor-product conventions remain the source target and require a separate present-day assessment.
